newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Calif. hydropower plant still shut.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Calif. hydropower plant still shut.

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co's 1,212 megawatt (MW) Helms pumped storage hydropower project is still undergoing repairs and inspection after a fire-related outage early this month, a company spokeswoman said Thursday.
An estimate for when the plant, located on the Kings River near Fresno, Calif., would restart remained uncertain.
"It's not so much the repairs that are extensive as it is the inspections of all the parts," the spokeswoman said.

The Helms unit operates as a "peaking" plant, producing power during daytime hours when power demand is highest. During off-peak hours at night the plant consumes power to move water uphill, where it is released to flow downhill through power turbines during the day.
